title: hypobathrum hirtum
intro: Hypobathrum hirtum, commonly known as the hairy hypobathrum or hairy bathtree, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, inflammation, and pain, as well as aiding in digestion and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hypobathrum hirtum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to alleviate a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
